title: Poses
description: Camera poses recovered from a generated take (e.g. Depth Anything 3), one entry per solved frame. Same convention as Shot after conversion: right-handed, Y-up, three.js; the camera looks down its local -Z; position is the camera centre and quaternion the camera-to-world rotation. World origin is the first solved camera and scale is arbitrary, so only Sim(3)-aligned comparison is meaningful. Frames may be a subset of the clip: t is seconds from clip start and the verifier interpolates onto the Shot's frame times. Cross-field rules not expressible here (enforced by the zod and pydantic mirrors): index and t strictly increasing; quaternions unit length; frames non-empty when solve_ok is true.

fps.description: Frame rate of the clip the poses were recovered from.

image.description: Pixel size the intrinsics refer to (the model's processed size, not necessarily the clip's).

solve_ok.description: False when the pose solve failed; the verifier then reports solveOk=false.

convention.description: Free-form provenance of the axes and units, for humans.

source.description: Free-form provenance of the solver (model, mode).

index.description: Frame index in the source clip.
